prompt:
Edit paint_mask_guide.png (first input), using design_reference.png (second input) as material/detail reference and icon_x8.png (third input) as color reference. Produce ONE transparent PNG, 1536x2048 or nearest 3:4 canvas. Strictly paint existing guide objects only, preserving exact silhouettes, positions, sizes, orientations, gaps and openings. The guide is a 3-column x 4-row grid of 512px cells: FRONT, BACK, LEFT / RIGHT, TOP, empty repeated in bottom half. Do not change its cameras or reorient objects; the object brief is "source-faithful pair vertical cuffs-down" but the guide's actual views and silhouettes are authoritative.
Rows 1-2 PAINT: unlit base color. Steel gauntlet with silver fingertip plates, charcoal gunmetal lower finger plates and main hand armor, two silver transverse knuckle plates, gold side trim and vertical gold wrist bands, silver flared cuff. Follow approved reference's subtle metal surface details, facets, engravings, scrollwork and inner swirls scaled to each view. Color reference is original game icon; magenta is background, never paint magenta. No lighting, cast shadows, ambient occlusion, hot highlights, reflections, halo, sparkles, aura, ground, outlines, text. Retain material colors but remove illumination from references. Paint all five guide views.
Rows 3-4 MATERIAL MASK: repeat same five guide silhouettes with corresponding material regions filled with FLAT PURE colors only: #FF0000 every metal part including steel, iron, chain mail, gold, silver, bronze, copper, brass; #00FF00 leather straps padding hide suede and fur; #0000FF cloth quilting linings cords ribbons and hair; #000000 gemstone crystal glass pearl enamel or liquid through glass. Every silhouette pixel gets exactly one color. NO shading, texture, outlines, antialiased color blends inside masks. This is predominantly metal armor, including charcoal metal. Never use grey or gold in bottom rows. Nothing outside silhouettes.
Empty third-column cells of rows 2 and 4 remain transparent. Preserve every guide gap and opening fully transparent. Do not add objects, redraw, enlarge, move, redesign or change layout. Output only the complete paint + mask atlas.
CORRECTIVE GENERATION: The previous attempt violated silhouette boundaries with red speckle clouds and had dark outline drawing inside material masks. Rebuild directly from the ORIGINAL grey guide provided here. Bottom five masks must be completely solid uniform #FF0000 silhouettes, with no internal lines whatsoever and ZERO stray pixels outside their precise original guide boundaries. Preserve original alpha silhouette exactly across all ten views. Top views must not invent large decorative relief or reflective lighting: use original reference subtle surface texture and flat albedo colors.
